title: One Bite On A Train To Busan . . . (Part 1)
caption:
One bite on a train, and half the passengers stopped being human 😱 Part 1 of 3. Follow so you don't miss Part 2!

#movierecap #traintobusan #zombie #kdrama #moviereview #recap #spoilerroom #fyp

segments.say: One bite on this train, and in *ten minutes*, half the passengers were not human anymore.
And the most *selfish* man on board had one job. Keep his little girl alive until the last stop.
But to understand why this ride went so wrong, we have to go back to that *morning*.
On a quiet road, a truck hit a deer. The driver drove away. Then the dead deer *stood back up*.
Its eyes were white. Its neck was *broken*. Nobody saw it. Nobody cared.
Meet Jack. A rich money man who never left the office, and never answered his phone at *home*.
His wife had left him. His little daughter Lily lived with him, but she barely *knew* him.

segments.text: Do you know tomorrow is her birthday?

segments.say: He forgot her birthday. So he bought her a game console. She already *had* the same one. He gave it to her last year.
Lily only wanted one present. To see her *mom*.

segments.text: Busan. I want to go to mom.

segments.say: So Jack took the morning train to Busan. Just one hour, then back to *work*.
But just before the doors closed, a girl with a bloody leg ran in, and fell down *shaking*.
On the train, Lily saw an old lady standing, and gave up her *seat*. Jack did not like that.
Remember what he said here. It will matter at the *end*.

segments.text: You don't have to do that. You should think only about yourself.

segments.say: Then the shaking girl twisted her neck, and *bit* a train attendant.
The attendant got up. And bit the next one. And the *next* one. Car after car fell.
Jack grabbed Lily and ran. A big tough guy, Big Mike, held the door shut with his *pregnant* wife Grace behind him.
On the TV, the whole country was in *riots*. This was not just one train.
So Jack did what Jack does. He called a friend in the army, and got a secret exit at Daejeon station. Only for him and Lily.
The train stopped. The army was there. Jack pulled Lily to a *different* gate, away from everyone else.
But Lily heard his phone call. She wanted to warn the *others*.

segments.text: Just think about yourself. — You only know about yourself. That's why mom left you.

segments.say: Then a soldier came walking down the stairs. Slowly. With his head *hanging* down.
The army was already *infected*. Every single soldier.
Hundreds of them poured down the escalator. Jack, Lily, Big Mike and Grace ran *back* to the train.
The doors were closing. Jack jumped on. Big Mike jumped on. The train *left*.
Jack was safe. He turned around to hug Lily. But Lily was not *there*.
She got on a car at the very *back*. With Grace and a homeless man, hiding in a toilet.
And between Jack and his daughter? Four train cars. *Full* of them.
Part 2 is up next. Follow so you don't miss how he *gets* her back.
